title: NVIDIA After Huang: Can Record Earnings Settle the AI Market’s Nerves?
description:
OpenAI just moved its newest models into the tools you use for work, and Google is letting Gemini make your phone calls. We’re breaking down what actually changes for your daily to-do list.

What we covered:
• NVIDIA Posts Strong Earnings Amid Leadership Transition
• OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol for work, coding, and agent workflows
• Google rolls out Gemini Tasks to let the assistant make calls and complete errands

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: When you delegate a task to an AI, what is your biggest fear?

What to watch next: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
